SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about African Traditional Education is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing African Traditional Education.
   B. Explain African Traditional Education with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat African Traditional Education as rumours only.
   D. Say African Traditional Education never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Population distribution in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Population distribution in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Population distribution in Kenya.
   C. Treat Population distribution in Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Explain Population distribution in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui.
   C. Say The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui as rumours only.

4. Which statement about School administration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing School administration.
   B. Say School administration never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat School administration as rumours only.
   D. Explain School administration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries.
   C. Treat Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries as rumours only.
   D. Explain Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

7. Which statement about Development of Transport is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Development of Transport.
   B. Treat Development of Transport as rumours only.
   C. Explain Development of Transport with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Development of Transport never happens in Kenya.

8. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Ignore prices in shops

9. Which statement about Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi.
   B. Say Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage.
   B. Treat Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage as rumours only.
   C. Explain Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Location, Position and Size of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Location, Position and Size of Kenya.
   B. Say Location, Position and Size of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Location, Position and Size of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Location, Position and Size of Kenya as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Weather and Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Weather and Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate.
   C. Say Weather and Climate never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Weather and Climate as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and Climate and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Population distribution in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Weather and Climate; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Population distribution in Kenya; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
